case.title: Dist Bs 1 — three gated bass notes
case.method: Inspected raw librarian patch parameters against Roland MIDI Implementation map. No engine synthesis parameters were optimized. Decoded official MP3 to stereo44.1kHz16-bit PCM; used channel mean for pitch and gating analysis. Detected six amplitude gates from4ms RMS of a100Hz high-pass analysis signal with10–50milliFS thresholds; threshold variation typically<6ms. Onset/gate intervals padded in uncertainty for MP3 and filter response. Confirmed sounding MIDI27 and29 using harmonic spectra and90ms-window autocorrelation; adding36 semitones reverses the documented oscillator coarse tune in both tones. Gate-on/off estimates do not distinguish silent keyboard onset from recording latency or encoded pre-echo.
